profile.description: Discriminator. redaction.prompt proves which redaction pass ran over a prompt/content blob before model send.

counts.description: Per-category PII removal counts (Partial<Record<RedactionCategory, number>>); categories EMAIL/IBAN/VAT/PHONE/CARD/CLIENT per @dekimuhq/redaction-profiles REDACTION_CATEGORIES.

ruleset_hash.description: sha256 commit of the golden-pinned detector corpus+version used for this pass.

redactor.description: Provenance string of the detector, e.g. "@dekimuhq/ai@2.4.0".
